name: easyplex-webpanel
description: EasyPlex 2.4 WebPanel & API recreated in React + Express + SQLite

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: node -e "if(process.env.CI||!require('fs').existsSync('client/node_modules/.bin/vite'))require('child_process').execSync('npm --prefix client clean-install --progress=false',{stdio:'inherit'})" && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
